subject.title: fix(gateway): deliver OAuth authorization URLs to non-terminal clients

question: Should OpenClaw accept `presentsAuthChallenge` as the plugin-facing WizardPrompter capability that makes RPC/non-terminal clients receive OAuth authorization URLs in-band instead of relying on gateway stdout or gateway-host browser opening?
rationale: The code shape is a plausible fix, but it creates a compatibility-sensitive provider auth contract and changes routing semantics for RPC wizard clients; that policy choice should be explicit before merge.

options.title: Accept After Proof And Rebase
options.body: Accept the new prompter capability once the branch is clean and the contributor adds redacted real-client proof for the Windows companion OAuth flow.

options.title: Narrow The Contract
options.body: Ask for a smaller repair that keeps provider routing unchanged and only adjusts the shared helper paths maintainers are ready to support.

options.title: Pause Behind RPC Parity
options.body: Keep the PR paused while the broader wizard RPC parity issue settles the auth, progress, and pairing protocol contract together.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof And Rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the new prompter capability once the branch is clean and the contributor adds redacted real-client proof for the Windows companion OAuth flow.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter's history covers both the provider OAuth helper extraction and the wizard/onboarding architecture that define this contract boundary.
